turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I'm listening, Hale. But start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone called me first.
I'm getting dozens of these essays now. What would a fair process for catching AI writing look like? What would you put in the policy?
You're asking me to do your job, Hale? The school already has a procedure, and 4.2 says a parent is called before any mark is entered. Nobody called me, so withdraw the zero.
